List the layers of a disturbance list that are not potential layers

Source: R/extractNonPotentialLayers.R
extractNonPotentialLayers.Rd

Potential layers, whose class name starts with "potential", show where a disturbance may happen; the other layers show where one has happened.

Usage

extractNonPotentialLayers(disturbanceList)

Arguments

disturbanceList

A list of lists of layers, named by sector and then by class.

Value

A data.table with columns Sector and dataClass, one row per sector and class whose name does not start with "potential". Unnamed sectors, sectors that are not lists and NA class names are skipped, and repeated rows are dropped.

Author

Tati Micheletti, Ronald Kilian

Examples

disturbanceList <- list(
  mining = list(mining = NULL, potentialMining = NULL),
  roads = list(roads = NULL)
)
extractNonPotentialLayers(disturbanceList)
#>    Sector dataClass
#>    <char>    <char>
#> 1: mining    mining
#> 2:  roads     roads
